close_reason: Applied option (a) per the bead's own recommendation: documented the serde_json version-pin contract in both README §Gotchas and a new PLAN.md §'serde_json version-pin contract'. Option (b) (opaque newtype) was rejected because the workspace extras-preservation policy commits to serde_json::Map<String,Value> as the public type across ~30 sibling crates; wrapping here alone would diverge. Tests + cargo doc -D warnings clean. Commit pending.
description:
lib.rs:964 declares AnniversaryDate::Unknown(serde_json::Value) as a public
enum variant. A caller pattern-matching this variant binds to a concrete
serde_json::Value type from whatever version of serde_json is pinned by this
crate's Cargo.toml.

If serde_json cuts a 2.0 release, this crate's API is broken twice:
- The public enum variant changes Value-type identity, so any caller that
  pattern-binds .Unknown(v) compiles against a different upstream major.
- The flatten-typed extras field carrying serde_json::Map<String,
  serde_json::Value> has the same issue 28 times over.

Workspace AGENTS.md explicitly tolerates the serde_json re-export in the
Sloppy-Value pattern section. So this is not a 'must fix' — it is a 'document
the version-pin contract so consumers know to also pin serde_json to the same
major'.

Three resolutions, pick one:

(a) Add a README and PLAN.md clause: 'This crate re-exports serde_json::Value
    and serde_json::Map in public APIs. Consumers MUST coordinate their
    serde_json major version with this crate's. A serde_json 2.0 upgrade
    requires a major-version bump here.'
(b) Wrap the Value in an opaque newtype: AnniversaryDate::Unknown(OpaqueValue),
    where OpaqueValue exposes only Serialize+Deserialize+Debug+Clone+PartialEq
    and no other public API. Costs a tiny adapter, hides the version pin.
    Breaking change to apply later.
(c) Status quo, no documentation change. Consumers discover the constraint
    when serde_json 2.0 lands and breaks their build.

Reading workspace policy, (a) is the lowest-cost answer that respects the
Sloppy-Value posture. The README §Gotchas already documents other footguns;
adding one line is harmless.
title: AnniversaryDate::Unknown(serde_json::Value) re-exports serde_json types via public enum variant — locks major version
